== Origins ==

Hm. I'd always seen it reasoned that Machin Shin was an offshoot of Mashadar, seeping through the Waygate in Shadar Logoth. Personally, I'd think it's a combination of the Taint's influence on the Ways and Mashadar oozing around the Gate...which would explain why it resembles Mashadar so much, and why it didn't harm Fain (both of them are half-way servants; part Dark One evil, part Shadar Logoth evil).

Also, as housekeeping (since I don't want to register), could somebody fix the origin section's formatting? There's an italics bleed in the opening, and it lists three possible origins despite the opening saying there are only two. Not big things, but things.
